test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select 'no improvement required'.**

Eighty girls sat there at four long tables, __doing their homework by__ candlelight.

options.text: to have done their homework with

solution:
The correct answer is: **no improvement is required**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **Past continuous** tense.
 
• **Past Continuous Tense indicates** an action which started in the past and continued in a certain time period.
 
• Structure of the Past Continuous Tense: ***Subject + was/were + present participle (verb+ing) + the rest of the sentence__***
 
 
• **Example -** *It was midnight when it was raining.*
 
 
 
• So, the given sentence is both **grammatically** and **conceptually correct.**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2**.
